text:
Alex: Observed a customer report where a prefetch heartbeat caused a toolcall to be truncated and both the prefetch and the main stream got provisional token credits. Looks like double-charge. Anyone else seen this? 
Sam: Can you paste the logs / request path? repro steps? 
Alex: Yep — here's the relevant headers and the tiny timeline:
```
x-session-id: s-9a1b
x-prefetch: true
x-heartbeat: 1
route: eu-west-1; tier:dedicated
```
logs:
```
[12:01:03] prefetch: sent heartbeat, kb=0, keepalive
[12:01:04] main-stream: client toolcall start
[12:01:04] prefetch: received EOF, issued truncate tombstone
[12:01:04] ledger: provisional credit prefetch + main-stream
```
Sam: OK so heartbeat and truncate happen within same second — looks like an ownership race. If ledger tags are based on first-seen prefix, prefetch may claim suffix ownership when TTL trimmed. 
Maria: My hunch: the prefetch worker emits a small heartbeat to keep its slot; when the main stream late-binds, the truncate tombstone is created by the prefetch path rather than the router that owns the full session. Ledger code then attributes tokens by path_id, so two agents win. 
Ryan: Do we have route-level attribution in the console? Customers are seeing confirmed vs provisional mismatch in the per-route token dashboard. The UI currently aggregates by session origin only. 
Joanne: Quick mitigation: debounce prefetch heartbeat for 200ms if a toolcall is in-flight on same session_id, and add a prefetch->router handoff ACK so only the router can stamp a truncate tombstone. Low-risk patch. 
Alex: That would help. Also we should add a temporary telemetry flag to mark provisional credits from prefetch so we can reconcile in billing backfill. 
billing-bot: Alert: customer billing delta > $120 in eu-west-1 for session s-9a1b. Investigating. 
Sam: For short-term fix, we can change ledger attribution to prefer route with active toolcall flag over prefetch path when timestamps are within 500ms. Then create a reconciliation job to move provisional -> confirmed properly. 
Maria: I'll prototype the handshake change and tracer tags (x-prefetch-handshake:true) to ensure only one tombstone generator. 
Ryan: For console UX: add a toggle to show provisional breakdown by path (hosted/dedicated/prefetch) so support can quickly triage. 
Joanne: Filing follow-ups: (1) debounce heartbeat PR, (2) handshake + tombstone patch, (3) telemetry tag + console toggle, (4) reconciliation job. Who wants ownership? 
Alex: I can own (1) and (4). Maria owns (2). Ryan + Sam pair on (3) and console bits. 
Sam: noted, will open RFC + tiny dashboard patch today. 
deploy-bot: Deploy queued for branch pref-heartbeat-debounce to staging. :truck: 
Alex: TY everyone, will post updates in #incidents if we see customer escalation.
